lines.say: What would happen if you fell into a giant pool of honey?
Well, here's the good news. Honey is denser than water, so you wouldn't sink. You'd float.
The bad news? Honey is thousands of times thicker than water.
Every arm stroke would feel like pushing through wet cement, and the harder you pull, the harder it pulls back.
Sounds crazy? In 1919, a giant wave of molasses flooded the streets of Boston, moving at thirty-five miles per hour.
People got stuck, and rescuers couldn't reach them for hours.
So you'd just lie there. Sticky. Exhausted. Waiting.
But don't worry. Honey never spoils.
Archaeologists will find you in three thousand years, perfectly preserved.
Would you try to swim, or just start eating? Comment below.
